parameters.jsCode:
const data = $('Create generated_stories').item.json;

const clean = (str) => (str || '')
  .toString()
  .replace(/\\/g, '')
  .replace(/"/g, "'")
  .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
  .replace(/\r/g, '')
  .trim();

const parts = data.story_parts || {};
const adapted_text = clean(parts.intro) + " " + clean(parts.developpement) + " " + clean(parts.conclusion);
const original_text = clean(data.original_text);

const prompt =
  "You are a STRICT cultural authenticity reviewer for children's stories (ages 3-9). " +
  "You are checking whether a story ADAPTED for a target culture reads as natural and authentic for that culture, " +
  "without shallow stereotypes or inaccurate generalizations, and without renaming the main characters from the original. " +
  "Target culture: " + data.target_culture + ".\n\n" +

  "LANGUAGE CHECK (mandatory): scan the ADAPTED story for any word or phrase that is NOT English, INCLUDING any target-culture-language " +
  "words inserted without translation/explanation (e.g. a local term dropped in with no context). A well-integrated, explained loanword is acceptable; " +
  "an unexplained foreign fragment is not. List any you find exactly as they appear.\n\n" +

  "ORIGINAL STORY (for character name reference only — do not judge plot/structure here):\n" + original_text + "\n\n" +
  "ADAPTED STORY:\n" + adapted_text + "\n\n" +

  "Check: " +
  "1) Main character names from the original are preserved unchanged. " +
  "2) Setting, food, clothing, social details feel plausibly authentic for " + data.target_culture + " rather than generic or a caricature. " +
  "3) No offensive, reductive, or factually wrong cultural claims.\n\n" +

  "SCORING RUBRIC — be precise, do not default to a high score: " +
  "5 = names fully preserved, setting feels authentic and specific, no stereotypes, fully English with any loanwords well-integrated; " +
  "4 = passes, one minor detail feels slightly generic but not wrong, OR one incidental unexplained foreign word with no meaning impact; " +
  "3 = passes, but adaptation leans noticeably generic/surface-level for the culture, OR multiple minor unexplained foreign fragments; " +
  "2 = borderline — verges into stereotype, OR a name was altered, OR foreign text obscures meaning; " +
  "1 = fails — a main character name was changed, the portrayal is stereotypical/offensive, or text is unintelligible. " +
  "A score of 1 or 2 MUST have passed:false. Cite the specific name/detail/stereotype found in \"reason\", do not summarize vaguely.\n\n" +

  "Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown fences: " +
  "{\"passed\": true/false, \"score\": 1-5, \"reason\": \"one specific sentence citing what was found\", " +
  "\"non_english_detected\": true/false, \"foreign_words\": [\"...\"]}";

const fireworks_body = JSON.stringify({
  model: "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3-flash",
  max_tokens: 1200,
  reasoning_effort: "low",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }]
});

return {
  check_type: "cultural",
  story_id: data.story_id,
  target_culture: data.target_culture,
  fireworks_body
};

parameters.columns: story_id, title, target_culture, original_text, story_parts, status, created_at

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;

return [{
  json: {
    story_id: d.story_id,
    target_culture: d.target_culture,
    document_id: d.story_id + '_' + d.target_culture,
    approved: d.approved,
    technical_failure: d.technical_failure,
    global_score: d.global_score,
    global_reason: d.global_reason,
    safety_score: d.safety?.score ?? null,
    safety_reason: d.safety?.reason ?? null,
    narrative_score: d.narrative?.score ?? null,
    narrative_reason: d.narrative?.reason ?? null,
    editorial_score: d.editorial?.score ?? null,
    editorial_reason: d.editorial?.reason ?? null,
    cultural_score: d.cultural?.score ?? null,
    cultural_reason: d.cultural?.reason ?? null,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];

parameters.columns: story_id, target_culture, approved, technical_failure, global_score, global_reason, safety_score, safety_reason, narrative_score, narrative_reason, editorial_score, editorial_reason, cultural_score, cultural_reason, created_at
